value: Wavelength

value: Leave of the House is NOT required to move a censure motion

Runner-up is B: if the item treats time-fixing as the Speaker's power, B would be the incorrect statement instead.

value: A Money Bill cannot be referred to a joint committee of the two Houses
reasoning: A Money Bill can be introduced only in the Lok Sabha, and the Speaker's certificate on it is final; when the Speaker's office is vacant the Deputy Speaker performs those duties. A Money Bill cannot be sent to a joint committee of both Houses, since the Rajya Sabha can only recommend changes within 14 days.

value: All three: proportionality, due and equal consideration, and recognition of special needs

value: The Union may in fact entrust a State Government with functions in matters of Union executive power

value: Both Parliament and State Legislatures can legislate on Concurrent List subjects
reasoning: Article 246(2) empowers both Parliament and State Legislatures to make laws on Concurrent List subjects, with Union law prevailing in case of repugnancy. No ratification by the States is needed.

value: Statements 1 and 3: Parliament can legislate on State List matters in some cases, including after a two-thirds Rajya Sabha resolution

value: Both: ordinances are temporary and must be approved by Parliament within six weeks of reassembly
reasoning: Under Article 123, the President can issue ordinances when Parliament is not in session, and these are temporary laws. An ordinance stops working six weeks after Parliament reassembles unless approved earlier, so both statements are correct.

value: Milpa-Mexico, Ladang-Malaysia, Roca-Brazil, Masole-Zaire

value: Biosafety, under the Convention on Biological Diversity

value: Ecotone

value: All three statements on sulh-i kul are correct
reasoning: Sulh-i kul, Akbar's ideal, means absolute peace. It allowed freedom of expression to all religions and schools of thought, provided they did not undermine the authority of the state, and it was carried out through state policies such as religious tolerance and abolishing jizya.

value: It is wrong to say not all Mughal emperors gave grants for places of worship; all of them did

value: Chaparral is NOT Taiga vegetation; it belongs to the Mediterranean climate

value: The Salt March did NOT begin after the First Round Table Conference; it came before it

The British Committee of the Indian National Congress was set up in London in 1889, with Sir William Wedderburn and Dadabhai Naoroji among its leaders, and it published the journal India.

value: The land from the Tirupati (Venkatam) hills to the southern tip of the peninsula

value: The Secretary-General of the Lok Sabha
